formats.key: snwap(address tokenIn,uint256 amountIn,address recipient,address tokenOut,uint256 amountOutMin,address executor,bytes executorData)
effects: When tokenIn is an ERC-20 and amountIn > 0, amountIn of tokenIn is pulled from the signer (safeTransferFrom) to the executor address, using the signer's allowance to RedSnwapper.
When amountIn == 0, the router's own tokenIn balance minus 1 is sent to the executor; nothing leaves the signer's wallet.
When tokenIn is the native address, no token is pulled; msg.value is forwarded through SafeExecutor to the executor.
msg.value (native ETH) is forwarded to the executor via SafeExecutor.execute.
executorData runs on the executor (from SafeExecutor, which holds no approvals, not in the signer's context).
The recipient's tokenOut balance (or native ETH balance when tokenOut is 0xEeee…) must grow by at least amountOutMin, or the call reverts.
formats.shown: "Swap {amountIn tokenIn} for at least {amountOutMin tokenOut/ETH} to {recipient}", with the same three fields; msg.value is forced to 0 and the executor and its data are hidden.

findings.title: snwap: the executor that receives the signer's input tokens is hidden.
findings.evidence: RedSnwapper.sol snwap: `tokenIn.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, executor, amountIn);` while descriptor has `{"path": "executor", "visible": "never"}`. In all cases the input went to 0xb365…9091, not to the router shown. The amountOutMin check on the recipient's balance bounds the outcome, so the result matches the screen.
findings.fix: Show executor as an addressName field (e.g. 'Swap via'), or at least visible: optional.

findings.title: snwap: amountIn of 0 means 'swap the router's leftover balance', but the screen shows 'Swap 0 TOKEN'.
findings.evidence: RedSnwapper.sol snwap: `else tokenIn.safeTransfer(executor, tokenIn.balanceOf(address(this)) - 1);` descriptor amountIn tokenAmount has no threshold or message for 0.
findings.fix: Add a label or a message for amountIn == 0 (e.g. 'Router balance, not from your wallet').

findings.title: snwap: native-ETH-input swaps cannot be clear-signed, and amountIn has no native currency mapping.
findings.evidence: descriptor `@.value` has `visible: {mustMatch: [0]}`, so the wallet errors on any ETH-in swap. The amountIn field uses `tokenPath: tokenIn` without `nativeCurrencyAddress`, so tokenIn = 0xEeee… would not resolve as ETH.
findings.fix: Show @.value as 'ETH Sent' (always visible when non-zero) and add nativeCurrencyAddress 0xEeee… to amountIn.

findings.title: snwap: executor fees cut from the input are decided in executorData; only the minimum output bounds them.
findings.evidence: Cases 0 and 3: the executor 0xb365… sent 14818272062260977 EIGEN and 17526821 USDT to 0xcd6b98…9799 before swapping. The signer still received more than amountOutMin (cases 0 and 3), which the code enforces.
findings.fix: None needed beyond the minimum received; the descriptor cannot decode executorData.
